Always running

Built for autonomous operation

Every piece is designed to run unattended — no babysitting, no approval loops, no surprise bills.

GitHub Actions runtime

Runs on GitHub's infrastructure — no VPS, no Docker, no Lambda. Free for public repos.

Self-healing agents

Skills monitor their own output quality and repair themselves when they break.

119 pre-built skills

PR reviews, market monitoring, content writing, vulnerability scans — drop-in and go.

Skill chaining

Compose agents into pipelines with parallel steps, conditional logic, and output passing.

Multi-model routing

Run Claude, GPT, Gemini, or Kimi per-skill. Switch models without rewriting logic.

Native desktop app

Mac, Windows, and Linux app with a visual editor, tray integration, and auto-updates.

Up and running in minutes

No infrastructure to provision. No Docker to learn.

01

Fork and configure

Fork the repo, set your Anthropic API key and GitHub token as repo secrets. Takes two minutes.

02

Enable skills

Open the dashboard, toggle the skills you want, set their schedules. Changes sync to your repo instantly.

03

It runs forever

GitHub Actions handles execution. Agents run on cron, react to events, and fix themselves when they fail.
